caption: This drawing shows a rectangular, wooden keyboard instrument with ornate detailing and a polished finish in shades of brown with golden accents. The body of the instrument features a keyboard with both white and black keys, frontal lattice panels, and a centrally placed framed plate. The entire body rests on six turned and carved legs, each with detailed grooves and gold embellishments at the top and bottom. There are decorative gold-colored handles and trim along the edges of the body, and a rectangular lid in the back section, partially open, revealing an inner compartment. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background and is signed "LAWRENCE PHILLIPS" in the bottom right corner.
title: Piano Forte
